description: Flags an approved return when the required action, such as issue_refund for an order, has not succeeded within the given number of business days after the entity approval-date field. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding the approval day. A violation occurs if the deadline has passed by state.today with no successful matching action in the trace, or if the matching action in the trace occurs on state.today after the deadline.
